qAndA.question: What color is the LED light that indicates the selected channel on the remote control?
How long should the "my" button be held to change the motor's direction?

qAndA.answer: The motor will stop rolling, but you can adjust the position further by pressing the up or down buttons before confirming the lower limit.
qAndA.question: What happens if you release the down button before the roller shutter reaches its desired lowest position?

qAndA.answer: It finalizes the programming process by closing the motor memory and storing the newly set limits.
qAndA.question: What is the purpose of the "prog" button on the back of the remote control?

qAndA.answer: Reset the motor to factory settings and start the programming process again, as this indicates an error in the programming sequence.
qAndA.question: What should you do if the motor does not respond correctly after completing the programming steps?

youtube_description:
When you have a new Somfy RTS motor, you need to set the upper and lower limit, check the direction in which it rolls and link a remote control.

In this video we show you all that:
- How to take control of the motor
- How to check and change the direction into which the motor turns
- How to set the lower limit
- How to set the upper limit
- How to memorise the settings

In this video, we use the Somfy Oximo RTS, but this procedure is identical for all RTS motors.

The Somfy Oximo RTS can be found here: http://www.motorise.it/motors/somfy/oximo-rts.html (UK only).

If you are not in the UK, please go here: http://www.tubularmotors.eu/oximo-50-rts/

The remote that's used is the Telis 4 RTS silver, but any RTS remote can be used.
